text:
marta: Photo drop — Marmot the tortoise discovered the living room sunspot and is refusing to move. Slow clap for naps. :turtle: pic: https://img.redwood.example/marmot_sunbeam.jpg
jess: OMG that shell gleam. I am powerless. :heart_eyes:
omar: This is the most dignified posture I have ever seen from a houseplant adjacent animal. :laughing:
linh: marmot.exe has entered hibernate mode 0x01. can we get a slo-mo? :eyes:
ravi: Can we put tiny sunglasses on him and start a band? "The Shelltones" would be iconic.
snapshot-bot: image uploaded by marta — marmot_sunbeam.jpg (2048x1365)
marta: need to know — is it a slow-burp or contemplative sigh? asking for a friend. :thinking_face:
jess: 100% contemplative sigh. Marmot is plotting world peace. :peace:
omar: also can confirm he refused a lettuce bribe at 3:12pm local time. very committed. :raised_hands:
linh: pinned for morale. anyone want a Marmot wallpaper? I can crop for phones. :camera_with_flash: 
ravi: yes please. and also a sticker pack. I'll pay in coffee. :coffee:
marta: sending higher-res in thread. thanks for indulging my tortoise content, team. :smile:
